message.content: An editorial illustration for Tempo magazine features a bright orange background. Three large, dark blue, gear-shaped wheels with black teeth and deep circular center-hollows dominate the center. The gears are interconnected; one large gear is positioned above another of similar size to the right, and a smaller third gear is below and to the left of the top one. A yellow, ribbon-like form is tangled within the teeth of the top gear, while another wavy yellow ribbon extends from the right-hand gear. Small, colorful geometric shapes, including green and red pyramids and blue wedges, are scattered around the gears. In the bottom-left corner, a small figure of a person sits hunched on the ground with their head in their arms. The person wears a grey shirt and dark pants with white-soled shoes. Large white text in the bottom-right reads "AWAS KREDIT MACET." Smaller white text below this says "JUMLAH PERUSAHAAN YANG GAGAL MENCICIL UTANG KE BANK MENINGKAT DIPICU MELEMAHNYA SEKTOR PERTAMBANGAN DAN KONSTRUKSI." The magazine's title, "TEMPO," appears in large red letters behind the gears. Additional black text at the top and bottom includes dates, prices, and barcodes.
